items.evidence: Log steps 1-129 dispense 5 uL master mix into all 96 wells, steps 132-513 add 4 uL primer pair, and steps 516-1473 add 1 uL colony template last, giving a 10 uL reaction.
Each primer_plate well (A1, B1, ... H12) is dispensed into the same pcr_plate well, and the same one-to-one mapping holds for colony_plate; no well is skipped or repeated.

One tip is used for master mix into empty wells and dropped (log 130), then a fresh tip is used for every primer transfer and every colony transfer, each followed by drop tip, and none is left on the pipette.

Comments record sealing the plate and a Q5 program: 98 C 3 min, 30 cycles of 98 C 10 s, Ta 20 s and 72 C 30 s/kb, final extension 72 C 2 min, then a 4 C hold; the annealing temperature is given by the Tm+3 rule (55-72 C) rather than a single number.

The protocol follows the paper's OT-2 workflow (9 uL master mix portion plus 1 uL template, 10 uL reaction, master mix before template, manual sealing and thermocycling), adapts to Q5 and per-colony primers with the assumption stated, and has an accurate citation.

judge.summary: The protocol sets up 96 reactions of 5 uL Q5 2x master mix, 4 uL matched primer pair and 1 uL colony template. The run log shows correct well mapping and a fresh tip for each primer and colony transfer. The sealing and Q5 thermocycling comments are reasonable and match the paper, though the annealing temperature is given as a rule (Tm+3 C) instead of a single value.
